items.author_bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
items.text:
Here’s another awesome use-case for what we can now do with our unstructured data because of AI agents. 

Box now works with Databricks so you can take structured data from enterprise content (like contracts, financial document, supply chain data) and connect that data into Databricks. 

This means that I can now query large document datasets without moving or reprocessing that content. And you can connect the data with any other system, like your ERP data, CRM, or product analytics. This opens up a ton of new use-cases for enterprise content. 

All possible because of headless software and agents.
items.summary: Box CEO 称因 AI agent 与无头软件，Box 现可与 Databricks 打通：合同、财务、供应链等企业内容抽出结构化数据后接入 Databricks，无需搬迁或重处理即可查询，并与 ERP/CRM/产品分析等系统连接，打开企业内容新用例。
items.recommend_reason: 企业内容库与湖仓直连，是 agent 时代数据底座的具体产品形态。
items.title: Box × Databricks：企业非结构化内容可直接接进数仓查询

items.author: VigoCreativeAI
items.author_bio: Designer × AI Engineer | Ambassador @Alibaba_Qwen | Cut e-commerce AI costs ~60%｜Reverse-engineering prompts from a single image
items.text:
Called it this afternoon. K3 went live tonight.

Opened Kimi and the model picker tells the story before any press release does:

▸ K3 · Max — chat & agent, flagship all-rounder
▸ K3 Swarm · Max — massive parallel search + batch processing in one session
▸ Up to 1M context

But the real signal isn't the specs. It's the new homepage line: "Hey work, let's build something."

This isn't a bigger chatbot. It's Kimi repositioning as an agent workbench — one model you talk to, one swarm you delegate to.

For creators, "batch processing" is the phrase to watch. Style validation, prompt matrices, mass variations — everything we run serially today is exactly what a swarm parallelizes.

Early testers are putting it at Opus-tier, some runs touching Fable territory. No official model card yet, so file that under vibes — but the vibes are loud.

Running my pipeline tests on Swarm mode tonight. Breakdown this week.

That "3" was never subtle. Neither is this.
items.summary: 作者称下午就预判晚上 K3 上线：选择器显示 K3 Max（对话与 agent 旗舰）与 K3 Swarm Max（海量并行搜索+批处理），上下文最高 1M。真正信号是主页「Hey work, let's build something」——Kimi 在把自己定位成 agent 工作台，而不是更大聊天机器人。创作者应盯 batch/swarm 并行；早期测试有人放到 Opus 档甚至摸到 Fable，尚无官方 model card。
items.recommend_reason: 从产品壳与双形态读 Kimi 战略，比单纯参数传闻更可操作。
items.title: Kimi K3 上线：Max / Swarm 双形态，主页文案已转向 agent 工作台

items.author: jxnlco
items.text:
new algo, same me

i’m jason. i work on developer experience for Codex at OpenAI. before that, i built Instructor and spent a lot of time helping people use language models to build real things.

these days, my job is somewhere between talking to developers, finding the interesting things people are building, fixing what feels broken, and working with Creative to tell those stories a little better.

i’m especially excited about voice. talking to your computer should feel as natural as thinking out loud, whether you’re writing code, making something, or halfway through another task.

things you’ll get from me:
• Codex experiments, tips, skills, and questionable automations
• people using coding agents for art, music, hardware, and other unexpected things
• developer feedback, open source, and whatever still feels painful
• occasional attempts to learn something new

things i want from you: what are you building? what should Codex do better? anyone using agents with, music, or other creative tools?

reply and introduce yourself 👇
items.summary: Jason 宣布加入 OpenAI 做 Codex 开发者体验：此前做 Instructor、帮人用语言模型落地；现在介于跟开发者聊天、找有趣项目、修体验痛点、和 Creative 讲故事之间。他尤其看好语音交互，计划分享 Codex 实验/技巧/skill、创意向 coding agent、开源反馈，并征求大家在建什么、Codex 该更好哪里。

2023: LLMs struggle with 4th grade word problems
2024: LLMs can do high school math

Where will we be next year?
